Tsenya letlha la Hijri go bona malatsi a Arafa, An-Nahr le Tashreeq
Tsenya letlha le le dirang la Hijri. Ngwaga go tloga ka 1300 go ya go 1600, kgwedi go tloga ka 1 go ya go 12, letsatsi go tloga ka 1 go ya go 30.

Tsenya letlha lengwe le lengwe la Hijri (kgotsa boloka letlha la ga jaana) go bona ka bonako malatsi a Hajj a ngwaga wa yone: Letsatsi la Arafah (9 Di-Hijjah), Letsatsi la An-Nahr (Di-Hijjat di le 10) le Malatsi a Tashreeq (11, 12 le 13 Di-Hijjah), le boemo mabapi le letlha la gago.
Pilara e kgolo go gaisa: ema kwa Arafah go tloga morago ga sethoboloko go fitlha letsatsi le phirima, o dira dikopo tse dintsi, takbir le tahlil. Moporofeti (PBUH) o rile: "Hajj ke Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: matlapa Jamarat al-Aqabah ka matlapana a supileng, nyehela sehlabelo, beola kapa poma, ebe o etsa Tawaf al-Ifadah le Sai.
Letsatsi la An-Nahr (Letsatsi la 10 la Hija)
Kitsiso ya letsatsi le letsatsi e e go gakololang ka ngwao e e ikaeletsweng ka nako ya yone mo malatsing a Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Kitsiso ya letsatsi le letsatsi e e go gakololang ka ngwao e e ikaeletsweng ka nako ya yone mo malatsing a Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Sunnah ya letsatsi leno: tsena mo ihram, tlhogo kwa Mina mme o robale koo, o boeletsa Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", mme o rapele koo o khutshwafaditswe ntle le go kopanya.

Topa Jamarat tse tharo morago ga sethoboloko: tse dinnye, morago ga moo tse di fa gare, morago ga moo tse dikgolo, matlapana a le supa mongwe le mongwe fa a ntse a re takbir, a kopa morago ga tse dinnye le tse di fa gare.
Malatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la 1 (11 Di-Hijjah)

Boeletsa go kgobotletsa Jamarat tse tharo ka maje morago ga sethoboloko jaaka maabane. Yo o eletsang go itlhaganela a ka tswa kwa Mina pele ga letsatsi le phirima; yo o salang o lala bosigo le matlapa ka letsatsi la boraro.
Malatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la bo 2 (Letsatsi la bo 12 la Hijjah)
Kgobotletsa Jamarat tse tharo ka maje morago ga sethoboloko, o bo o konela Hajj ka Tawaf ya go laelana fa o tswa Makkah. Ekete Allah a ka amogela Hajj ya gago.
Malatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la bo 3 (Letsatsi la bo 13)

Tshupiso e e akaretsang ya Hajj le Umrah: tlhaloso le dikatlholo, mefuta ya dingwao, mawaqit, dingwao kgato ka kgato ka botlhale jwa tsone le se se ka buiwang kwa seteisheneng sengwe le sengwe, dithibelo tsa ihram, le dikopo. Tlhopha karolo e o batlang go e sekaseka.
